hydration.counting.info: Hydration-adjusted counting multiplies each drink’s volume by its Beverage Hydration Index (BHI). Still water is 1.0. Full-fat and skimmed milk scored about 1.5–1.6 over two hours versus water; sparkling water, tea, coffee, cola, sports drink and lager were not different from water (Maughan et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2016; DOI 10.3945/ajcn.115.114769). Moderate coffee also matched water for net fluid balance in habituated drinkers (Killer et al., PLOS ONE 2014; DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0084154). Raw volume ignores BHI. Water-only ignores non-water drinks.
